description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git diff functionalities with various options such as -G and -S, particularly focusing on regex matching and pickaxe options in Git. It sets up test cases, creates a file with zeroes, and verifies diff outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given label and commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates an initial Git commit with specified files.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or environment to simulate time passage.
